page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r9i.6xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 24 dedicated vCPUs utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The processing power is delivered by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at a base frequency of 3.2 GHz. The instance is equipped with 192.0 GB of system memory, establishing a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This instance configuration does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. It also lacks dedicated GPU hardware, making it unsuitable for hardware-accelerated graphics or parallel computing workloads. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 15 Gbps. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.r9i.6xlarge offers high memory density per dedicated vCPU, which is advantageous for workloads requiring substantial RAM without scaling up vCPU counts unnecessarily. This resource profile is designed for memory-intensive applications, including in-memory databases, caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, and large-scale data processing tasks that fit within the 192.0 GB memory envelope.
